summary: validate-modules codes for type mismatches, documentation errors, import placement and check_mode attribute consistency.

answer_card.title: validate-modules codes (imports and attributes)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `doc-type-does-not-match-spec`: type differs
- `documentation-error` / `documentation-syntax-error`: bad DOCUMENTATION
- `import-before-documentation`, `imports-improper-location` (error), `import-placement` (warning): imports must be below `DOCUMENTATION`/`EXAMPLES`/`RETURN`
- `import-error`: module couldn't be imported for introspection
- `attributes-check-mode`: documented support must match `supports_check_mode`
- `attributes-check-mode-details`: `partial`/`N/A` need `details`
